__comment: SKB-004 / packet B1, project-shaped half: an AUTHORED master_volume of 0 in a project JSON means silence — the emitted project_init must read `p.master_volume = 0.000000000`. Both readers of .skald.json share resolved_master_volume, and this fixture plus graph_session_master_zero pin that they cannot drift apart. The flat-directory project fixtures (sine_440 etc.) all author a positive master_volume, so this is also the only project-shaped pin on the zero boundary. Golden-only on purpose: a silent render has no FFT features for the acceptance harness to assert.
